children.text: tad āhur yasya gārhapatyāhavanīyau mithaḥ saṃsṛjyeyātāṃ kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye vītaye 'ṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye agna āyāhi vītaye yo agniṃ devavītaya ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye vītaye svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: When a man's <s>gārhapatya</s> and <s>āhavanīya</s> fires become mixed with each other, what is the expiation in that case? He should prepare an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> cake for <s>Agni Vītaye</s>. Its <s>yājyā</s> and <s>anuvākyā</s> verses are those beginning <s>agna āyāhi vītaye</s> and <s>yo agniṃ devavītayaḥ</s>; or he should make an oblation in the <s>āhavanīya</s>, saying, <s>agnaye vītaye svāhā</s>. That is the expiation in that case.

children.text: tad āhur yasya sarva evāgnayo mithaḥ saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye vivicaye 'ṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye svar ṇa vastor uṣasām aroci tvām agne mānuṣīr īﾱate viśa ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye vivicaye svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: When all of a man's fires become mixed with one another, what is the expiation in that case? He should prepare an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> cake for <s>Agni Vivicaye</s>. Its <s>yājyā</s> and <s>anuvākyā</s> verses are those beginning <s>svar ṇa vastor uṣasām aroci</s> and <s>tvām agne mānuṣīr īḍate viśaḥ</s>; or he should make an oblation in the <s>āhavanīya</s>, saying, <s>agnaye vivicaye svāhā</s>. That is the expiation in that case.

children.text: tad āhur yasyāgnayo anyair agnibhiḥ saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye kṣāmavate'ṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye akrandad agni stanayann iva dyaur adhā yathā naḥ pitaraḥ parāsa ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye kṣāmavate svāheti sa tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: When a man's fires become mixed with other fires, what is the expiation in that case? He should prepare an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> cake for <s>Agni Kṣāmavat</s>. Its <s>yājyā</s> and <s>anuvākyā</s> verses are those beginning <s>akrandad agni stanayann iva dyauḥ</s> and <s>adhā yathā naḥ pitaraḥ parāsaḥ</s>; or he should make an oblation in the <s>āhavanīya</s>, saying, <s>agnaye kṣāmavate svāhā</s>. That is the expiation in that case.

children.text: Chapter 230

tad āhur yasyāgnayo grāmyeṇāgninā saṃdahyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye saṃvargāyāṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye kuvit su no gaviṣṭaye mā no asmin mahādhana ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye saṃvargāya svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: When a man's fires are burned together by a village fire, what is the expiation in that case? He should prepare an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> cake for <s>Agni Saṃvarga</s>. Its <s>yājyā</s> and <s>anuvākyā</s> verses are those beginning <s>kuvit su no gaviṣṭaye</s> and <s>mā no asmin mahādhane</s>; or he should make an oblation in the <s>āhavanīya</s>, saying, <s>agnaye saṃvargāya svāhā</s>. That is the expiation in that case.

children.text: tad āhur yasyāgnayo divyenāgninā saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye 'psumate 'ṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye apsv agne sadhiṣ ṭava mayo dadhe medhiraḥ pūtadakṣa ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye 'psumate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: When a man's fires become mixed with a heavenly fire, what is the expiation in that case? He should prepare an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> cake for <s>Agni Apsumant</s>. Its <s>yājyā</s> and <s>anuvākyā</s> verses are those beginning <s>apsv agne sadhiṣ ṭava</s> and <s>mayo dadhe medhiraḥ pūtadakṣaḥ</s>; or he should make an oblation in the <s>āhavanīya</s>, saying, <s>agnaye 'psumate svāhā</s>. That is the expiation in that case.

children.text: tad āhur yasyāgnayaḥ śavāgninā saṃsṛjyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye śucaye 'ṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye agniḥ śucivratatama ud agne śucayas tavety āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye śucaye svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: When a man's fires become mixed with a corpse-fire, what is the expiation in that case? He should prepare an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> cake for <s>Agni Śuci</s>. Its <s>yājyā</s> and <s>anuvākyā</s> verses are those beginning <s>agniḥ śucivratatamaḥ</s> and <s>ud agne śucayas tava</s>; or he should make an oblation in the <s>āhavanīya</s>, saying, <s>agnaye śucaye svāhā</s>. That is the expiation in that case.

children.text: tad āhur yasyāgnaya āraṇyenāgninā saṃdahyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir iti sam evāropayed araṇī volmukaṃ vā mokṣayed yady āhavanīyād yadi gārhapatyād yadi na śaknuyāt so'gnaye saṃvargāyāṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasyokte yājyānuvākye āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye saṃvargāya svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: When a man's fires are burned together by a forest fire, what is the expiation in that case? He should cause it to be mounted together, or he should release a fire-drill or a firebrand, whether from the <s>āhavanīya</s> or from the <s>gārhapatya</s>. If he cannot do so, he should prepare an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> cake for <s>Agni Saṃvarga</s>. Its <s>yājyā</s> and <s>anuvākyā</s> verses have been stated; or he should make an oblation in the <s>āhavanīya</s>, saying, <s>agnaye saṃvargāya svāhā</s>. That is the expiation in that case.

children.text: Chapter 231

tad āhur ya āhitāgnir upavasathe 'śru kurvīta kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye vratabhṛte 'ṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye tvamagne vratabhṛc chucir vratāni bibhrad vratapā adabdha ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye vratabhṛte svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: "If an <s>āhitāgni</s> (one who has established the sacred fires) should shed tears on the <s>upavasatha</s> (fast-day), what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that?" He should offer an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial cake) to <s>Agni Vratabhṛt</s>. Its <s>yājyānuvākya</s> verses are "You, <s>Agni</s>, are the bearer of vows, pure, bearing the vows," and "guardian of vows, undeceived." Or he should pour an oblation into the <s>āhavanīya</s> fire, saying, "To <s>Agni Vratabhṛt</s>, svāhā." That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> in that case.

children.text: tad āhur ya āhitāgnir upavasathe 'vratyam āpadyeta kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye vratapataye 'ṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye tvam agne vratapā asi yad vo vayam pramināma vratānīty āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye vratapataye svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: "If an <s>āhitāgni</s> should fall into breach of vow on the <s>upavasatha</s>, what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?" He should offer an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> to <s>Agni Vratapati</s>. Its <s>yājyānuvākya</s> verses are "You, <s>Agni</s>, are the guardian of vows" and "whatever vows of yours we violate." He should pour an oblation into the <s>āhavanīya</s> fire, saying, "To <s>Agni Vratapati</s>, svāhā." That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> in that case.

children.text: tad āhur ya āhitāgnir amāvāsyām paurṇamāsīṃ vātīyāt kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye pathikṛte 'ṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye vetthā hi vedho 'dhvana ā devānām api panthām aganmety āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye pathikṛte svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: "If an <s>āhitāgni</s> should let the new-moon or full-moon rite pass by, what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?" He should offer an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> to <s>Agni Pathikṛt</s>. Its <s>yājyānuvākya</s> verses are "For you know the paths, O ordainer" and "we have come upon the path even of the gods." He should pour an oblation into the <s>āhavanīya</s> fire, saying, "To <s>Agni Pathikṛt</s>, svāhā." That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> in that case.

children.text: tad āhur yasya sarva evāgnaya upaśāmyeran kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate 'ṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye āyāhi tapasā janeṣv ā no yāhi tapasā janeṣv ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: "If all of someone's fires should go out, what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?" He should offer an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> to <s>Agni Tapasvat Janadvat Pāvakavat</s>. Its <s>yājyānuvākya</s> verses are "Come with fervor among the people" and "come to us with fervor among the people." He should pour an oblation into the <s>āhavanīya</s> fire, saying, "To <s>Agni Tapasvat Janadvat Pāvakavat</s>, svāhā." That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> in that case.

children.text: Chapter 232

tad āhur ya āhitāgnir āgrayaṇenāniṣṭvā navānnam prāśnīyāt kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye vaiśvānaro ajījanat pṛṣṭo divi pṛṣṭo agniḥ pṛthivyām ity āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye vaiśvānarāya svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: "If an <s>āhitāgni</s> should eat new grain without having sacrificed with the <s>āgrayaṇa</s>, what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?" He should offer a twelve-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> to <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>. Its <s>yājyānuvākya</s> verses are "<s>Vaiśvānara</s> generated" and "pressed in heaven, <s>Agni</s> pressed on earth." He should pour an oblation into the <s>āhavanīya</s> fire, saying, "To <s>Agni Vaiśvānara</s>, svāhā." That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> in that case.

children.text: tad āhur ya āhitāgnir yadi kapālaṃ naśyet kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'śvibhyāṃ dvikapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye aśvinā vartir asmad ā gomatā nāsatyā rathenety āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād aśvibhyāṃ svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: "If, for an <s>āhitāgni</s>, a potsherd should be lost, what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?" He should offer a two-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> to the <s>Aśvins</s>. Its <s>yājyānuvākya</s> verses are "O <s>Aśvins</s>, with your path toward us" and "O <s>Nāsatyas</s>, with a cattle-rich chariot." He should pour an oblation into the <s>āhavanīya</s> fire, saying, "To the <s>Aśvins</s>, svāhā." That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> in that case.

children.text: tad āhur ya āhitāgnir yadi pavitraṃ naśyet kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye pavitravate 'ṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye pavitraṃ te vitatam brahmaṇas pate tapoṣ pavitraṃ vitataṃ divas pada iti āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye pavitravate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: "If, for an <s>āhitāgni</s>, the strainer should be lost, what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?" He should offer an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> to <s>Agni Pavitravat</s>. Its <s>yājyānuvākya</s> verses are "Your strainer is stretched out, O lord of prayer" and "the strainer of fervor is stretched to the place of heaven." He should pour an oblation into the <s>āhavanīya</s> fire, saying, "To <s>Agni Pavitravat</s>, svāhā." That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> in that case.

children.text: tad āhur ya āhitāgnir yadi hiraṇyaṃ naśyet kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye hiraṇyavate 'ṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye hiraṇyakeśo rajaso visāra ā te suparṇā aminantam evair iti āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye hiraṇyavate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: "If, for an <s>āhitāgni</s>, the gold should be lost, what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?" He should offer an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> to <s>Agni Hiraṇyavat</s>. Its <s>yājyānuvākya</s> verses are "golden-haired, spreading through the region" and "to you the fair-winged ones," as the transmitted verse continues. He should pour an oblation into the <s>āhavanīya</s> fire, saying, "To <s>Agni Hiraṇyavat</s>, svāhā." That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> in that case.

children.text: tad āhur ya āhitāgnir yadi prātar asnāto 'gnihotraṃ juhuyāt kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye varuṇāyāṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya vidvān sa tvaṃ no agne 'vamo bhavotīty āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye varuṇāya svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: "If an <s>āhitāgni</s> should offer the morning <s>agnihotra</s> without having bathed, what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?" He should offer an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> to <s>Agni Varuṇa</s>. Its <s>yājyānuvākya</s> verses are "You, <s>Agni</s>, knowing the ways of <s>Varuṇa</s>," and "so you, <s>Agni</s>, be nearest to us with aid." He should pour an oblation into the <s>āhavanīya</s> fire, saying, "To <s>Agni Varuṇa</s>, svāhā." That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> in that case.

children.text: tad āhur ya āhitāgnir yadi sūtakānnam prāśnīyāt kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnāye tantumate 'ṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye tantuṃ tanvan rajaso bhānum anv ihy akṣānaho nahyatanota somyā iti āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye tantumate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: "If an <s>āhitāgni</s> should eat food connected with birth impurity, what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?" He should offer an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> to <s>Agni Tantumat</s>. Its <s>yājyānuvākya</s> verses are "stretching the thread, follow the light of the region" and "the Soma-related ones stretched the unbroken one for us." He should pour an oblation into the <s>āhavanīya</s> fire, saying, "To <s>Agni Tantumat</s>, svāhā." That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> in that case.

children.text: tad āhur ya āhitāgnir jīve mṛtaśabdaṃ śrutvā kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnāye surabhimate 'ṣṭākapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye agnir hotā ny asīdad yajīyān sādhvīm akar devavītiṃ no adyety āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye surabhimate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: "If an <s>āhitāgni</s> should hear a report of death concerning someone still alive, what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?" He should offer an eight-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> to <s>Agni Surabhimat</s>. Its <s>yājyānuvākya</s> verses are "<s>Agni</s>, the hotṛ, has sat down, most fit for sacrifice" and "he has made our divine journey fair today." He should pour an oblation into the <s>āhavanīya</s> fire, saying, "To <s>Agni Surabhimat</s>, svāhā." That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> in that case.

children.text: tad āhur ya āhitāgnir yasya bhāryā gaur vā yamau janayet kā tatra prāyaścittir iti so 'gnaye marutvate trayodaśakapālam puroﾱāśaṃ nirvapet tasya yājyānuvākye maruto yasya hi kṣaye 'rā ived acaramā ahevety āhutiṃ vāhavanīye juhuyād agnaye marutvate svāheti sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: "If, for an <s>āhitāgni</s>, his wife or his cow should give birth to twins, what is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> for that?" He should offer a thirteen-cup <s>puroḍāśa</s> to <s>Agni Marutvat</s>. Its <s>yājyānuvākya</s> verses are "The <s>Maruts</s>, in whose dwelling" and "like spokes, unfailing, by day." He should pour an oblation into the <s>āhavanīya</s> fire, saying, "To <s>Agni Marutvat</s>, svāhā." That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> in that case.

children.text: tad āhur apatnīko 'py agnihotram āharait nāharait iti ||
children.translated_text: They say: "Even if a man has no wife, should he maintain the <s>agnihotra</s>, or should he not maintain it?"

children.text: āhared ity āhuḥ ||
children.translated_text: They say: "He should maintain it."

children.text: yadi nāhared anaddhā puruṣaḥ ||
children.translated_text: If he did not maintain it, the man would be unestablished.

children.text: ko 'naddhāpuruṣa iti na devān na pitṝn na manuṣyān iti ||
children.translated_text: "Who is an <s>anaddhāpuruṣa</s>?" It means: neither among the gods, nor among the Fathers, nor among human beings.

children.text: tasmād apatnīko 'py agnihotram āharet ||
children.translated_text: Therefore even a man without a wife should maintain the <s>Agnihotra</s>.

children.text: tad eṣābhi yajñagāthā gīyate ||
children.translated_text: On this point this sacrificial verse is sung:

children.text: yajet sautrāmaṇyām apatnīko 'py asomapaḥ mātāpitṛbhyām anṛṇārthād yajeti vacanāc chrutir iti ||
children.translated_text: "He should sacrifice in the <s>Sautrāmaṇī</s>, even if he is without a wife, even if he has not drunk Soma, because scripture says, 'Let him sacrifice for the purpose of becoming free from debt to his mother and father.'"

children.text: tasmāt saumyaṃ yājayet ||
children.translated_text: Therefore he should have a <s>saumya</s> rite performed.
